Change Description: New Lottie auto-play animation on app launch
Test Scenario: Verify existing bottom nav tab navigation unaffected when animation feature disabled
Preconditions: Animation disabled or CMS config missing; logged-in user
Test Steps:
1. Launch app without animation config
2. Tap each bottom nav icon sequentially
3. Verify screen navigation
Expected Result: All bottom nav tabs navigate correctly to respective screens without regression

Test Scenario: Verify Home icon always-selected behaviour unchanged after animation feature
Preconditions: Post-feature app version; any CMS animation config
Test Steps:
1. Launch app
2. Observe Home icon on various tabs
3. Navigate away from Home and return
Expected Result: Home icon remains always selected/highlighted as before; animation feature does not alter Home hardcoded behaviour

Change Description: Selected/unselected static icon states for non-animating icons
Test Scenario: Verify non-animating bottom nav icons retain correct selected/unselected states
Preconditions: Animation configured for one icon only; user navigates all tabs
Test Steps:
1. Cold start with animation on Favourites
2. Navigate to Live TV, On Demand, My Account
3. Verify selected/unselected states
Expected Result: Non-animating icons display correct selected/unselected static states without visual regression

Test Scenario: Verify existing Lottie rendering elsewhere in app is not broken by bottom nav animation
Preconditions: App with existing Lottie integrations; animation feature enabled
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to other app areas using Lottie animations
2. Verify rendering
3. Return to bottom nav and trigger auto-play
Expected Result: Existing Lottie integrations continue to render correctly; no library conflict from bottom nav animation
